title: 天文雷射導引星~Astronomical laser guide stars
focus: 鈉層共振散射、錐效應與傾斜不確定性、589 nm 雷射源、回波光子預算、光點拉長、對焦追蹤與多雷射整合~Sodium resonance scattering, cone effect and tilt indeterminacy, 589 nm sources, return-photon budgets, spot elongation, focus tracking and multi-laser integration
summary: 以約 90 km 高的中氣層鈉層與 ESO VLT 4LGSF 的四道 22 W 鈉雷射為主軸，從 D2 線吸收截面推到每平方公尺每秒的回波光子數，再處理錐效應、無法由雷射量測的 tip-tilt、光點拉長、鈉層高度造成的假離焦與多雷射互擾，最後落到運轉協調與驗收紀錄。~Built around the mesospheric sodium layer near 90 km and the four 22 W sodium lasers of ESO's VLT 4LGSF, this course goes from the D2 absorption cross-section to returned photons per square metre per second, then handles the cone effect, the tip-tilt a laser cannot measure, spot elongation, false defocus from sodium altitude and multi-laser cross-talk, ending with operational coordination and acceptance records.

units.anchor: 中氣層鈉原子層~Mesospheric sodium layer
units.title: 鈉層共振散射與吸收截面~Sodium-layer resonance scattering and cross-section
units.mechanism: 流星燒蝕留下的鈉原子在約 90 km 高、厚約 10 km 的中氣層形成一層稀薄的原子層，柱密度通常為每平方公分數十億個原子，並隨季節、緯度與夜間時間變化。把雷射調到鈉 D2 線 589.16 nm，鈉原子吸收後自發輻射，向各方向發出同波長的光，從地面看就像一顆位於 90 km 的人造星。鈉原子溫度約 190 K，都卜勒展寬約 1 GHz，遠大於約 10 MHz 的自然線寬，所以雷射的線寬、頻率準確度與偏振直接決定能激發多少原子。~Sodium deposited by meteor ablation forms a thin atomic layer in the mesosphere about 90 km high and roughly 10 km thick, with a column density of a few billion atoms per square centimetre that varies with season, latitude and time of night. A laser tuned to the sodium D2 line at 589.16 nm is absorbed and re-emitted spontaneously in all directions at the same wavelength, so from the ground it looks like an artificial star at 90 km. At about 190 K the sodium Doppler width is near 1 GHz, far larger than the roughly 10 MHz natural linewidth, so the laser's linewidth, frequency accuracy and polarisation directly decide how many atoms are excited.
units.model: D2 振子強度 f = 0.641，積分截面 (πe²/m_ec)·f ≈ 0.0265 × 0.641 ≈ 0.017 cm²·Hz；T = 190 K 時都卜勒半高全寬 Δν_D ≈ 1.05 GHz，峰值截面 ≈ 0.017 × 0.939/(1.05×10⁹ Hz) ≈ 1.5×10⁻¹¹ cm²，D2a 分量佔 5/8，約 9.5×10⁻¹² cm²。柱密度 4×10⁹ cm⁻² 時光學厚度 τ = σ·C_Na ≈ 0.038，也就是窄頻低強度下只有約 4% 的雷射光子被鈉層吸收。~The D2 oscillator strength is f = 0.641, so the integrated cross-section is (πe²/m_ec)·f ≈ 0.0265 × 0.641 ≈ 0.017 cm²·Hz; at T = 190 K the Doppler FWHM is Δν_D ≈ 1.05 GHz and the peak cross-section ≈ 0.017 × 0.939/(1.05×10⁹ Hz) ≈ 1.5×10⁻¹¹ cm², of which the D2a component carries 5/8, about 9.5×10⁻¹² cm². With a column density of 4×10⁹ cm⁻² the optical depth τ = σ·C_Na ≈ 0.038, so a narrowband low-intensity laser loses only about 4% of its photons to the sodium layer.
units.verify: 以鈉雷射雷達量測鈉層柱密度與高度剖面，並與季節性統計比較；在實驗室以鈉蒸氣室掃描雷射頻率，確認 D2a 與 D2b 兩個超精細峰相隔約 1.77 GHz，據此校正雷射的絕對頻率，並記錄鎖定點相對 D2a 峰的偏差。~Measure sodium column density and altitude profile with a sodium lidar and compare with seasonal statistics; in the laboratory scan the laser frequency across a sodium vapour cell, confirm that the D2a and D2b hyperfine peaks are about 1.77 GHz apart, use them to calibrate the absolute laser frequency, and record the offset of the lock point from the D2a peak.
units.failure: 雷射頻率偏離 D2a 峰數百 MHz 時，回波光子數依都卜勒輪廓迅速下降，自適應光學看到的導引星變暗、波前感測雜訊升高；若把回波下降誤歸因於鈉層季節變化而不檢查頻率鎖定，問題會持續整夜。~When the laser drifts a few hundred megahertz off the D2a peak, return photons fall rapidly along the Doppler profile, the guide star dims for the adaptive optics and wavefront-sensor noise rises; blaming the drop on seasonal sodium changes instead of checking the frequency lock lets the problem persist all night.
units.misconception: 鈉層像一面鏡子，打上去的雷射光大部分會被反射回來。~The sodium layer acts like a mirror and reflects most of the laser light back.

units.anchor: 雷射光錐與大氣湍流層~Laser cone and turbulent layers
units.title: 錐效應、焦點非等暈與傾斜不確定性~Cone effect, focal anisoplanatism and tilt indeterminacy
units.mechanism: 自然星的光以平行光柱穿過大氣，雷射導引星卻位於有限高度，回波光在望遠鏡瞳面形成一個光錐；高度 h 的湍流層只被半徑縮小為 (1 − h/H) 的部分取樣，邊緣的湍流沒被量到，這就是錐效應，也稱焦點非等暈。導引星越低、口徑越大，問題越嚴重。此外雷射上行與回波下行穿過同一段大氣，導引星在天空的位置抖動同時包含上行與下行的傾斜，兩者無法分離，所以整體 tip-tilt 必須另由一顆自然星量測。瑞利導引星利用 10 到 20 km 高的空氣分子散射，亮度高，但錐效應遠比鈉導引星嚴重，多用於地表層自適應光學。~Light from a natural star crosses the atmosphere as a parallel column, but a laser guide star sits at finite altitude and its return forms a cone at the pupil; a layer at height h is sampled only over a region shrunk by (1 − h/H), leaving turbulence at the edge unmeasured, which is the cone effect or focal anisoplanatism, worse for lower beacons and larger apertures. The laser also travels up and the return comes down through the same air, so the beacon's position jitter on the sky mixes uplink and downlink tilt that cannot be separated, and overall tip-tilt must come from a natural star. Rayleigh beacons use molecular scattering at 10 to 20 km and are bright, but their cone effect is far worse than sodium's, so they mainly serve ground-layer adaptive optics.
units.model: 8.2 m 口徑、鈉導引星 H = 90 km：h = 10 km 層的取樣直徑 D(1 − h/H) ≈ 7.29 m，外緣未取樣環寬約 0.46 m；瑞利導引星 H = 15 km 時取樣直徑只剩 2.73 m，未取樣環寬 2.73 m。對 h = 5 km 的層，鈉導引星與 12 km 瑞利導引星的取樣直徑分別為 7.74 m 與 4.78 m，說明瑞利星只能有效修正最低層湍流。~For an 8.2 m aperture and a sodium beacon at H = 90 km, a layer at h = 10 km is sampled over D(1 − h/H) ≈ 7.29 m, leaving an unsampled rim about 0.46 m wide; a Rayleigh beacon at H = 15 km samples only 2.73 m, leaving a 2.73 m wide rim. For a layer at h = 5 km the sampled diameters are 7.74 m for sodium and 4.78 m for a 12 km Rayleigh beacon, which is why Rayleigh beacons correct only the lowest turbulence effectively.
units.verify: 以同一顆亮自然星交替或同時做 NGS 與 LGS 波前量測，比較兩者重建的波前差，殘差應集中在瞳面外緣，並隨 SCIDAR 或 MASS 量得的湍流高度剖面而變；tip-tilt 不確定性則以 LGS 回報的整體傾斜與 NGS 傾斜之間相關係數接近零來確認。~Measure the wavefront with NGS and LGS on the same bright natural star, alternately or simultaneously, and compare the reconstructions; the difference should concentrate at the pupil rim and track the turbulence profile measured by SCIDAR or MASS. Confirm tilt indeterminacy by showing that the global tilt reported by the LGS is nearly uncorrelated with the NGS tilt.
units.failure: 若以為 LGS 可提供完整波前而省略自然星傾斜感測，長曝光影像被大氣傾斜抹成寬團塊，改善非常有限；在高層湍流強的夜晚仍以單顆 LGS 做窄場修正，外緣殘差會讓近紅外 Strehl 明顯低於預估。~Assuming the LGS provides the complete wavefront and omitting natural-star tilt sensing smears long exposures into broad blobs with very little improvement; using a single LGS for narrow-field correction on nights with strong high-altitude turbulence leaves rim residuals that push near-infrared Strehl well below prediction.
units.misconception: 有了雷射導引星，就完全不需要任何自然導引星。~With a laser guide star, no natural guide star is needed at all.

units.anchor: 1178 nm 拉曼光纖放大與倍頻器~1178 nm Raman fibre amplifier and doubler
units.title: 589 nm 雷射源：頻率、線寬、回泵與偏振~589 nm source: frequency, linewidth, repumping and polarisation
units.mechanism: 現代鈉導引星雷射多為連續波系統：窄線寬二極體種子雷射在 1178 nm 起振，經拉曼光纖放大器放大到數十瓦，再以共振腔倍頻得到 589 nm，ESO 4LGSF 每道約 22 W。拉曼光纖放大的難點是在高功率下抑制受激布里淵散射，同時把線寬維持在遠窄於鈉超精細結構的程度。為了提高回波，雷射採圓偏振，以光泵把原子推進循環躍遷，並把約一成功率移到 D2b 頻率做回泵，避免原子停在不吸收的基態；地磁場造成的拉莫進動會削弱光泵效果。~Modern sodium guide-star lasers are mostly continuous-wave systems: a narrow-linewidth diode seed at 1178 nm is amplified to tens of watts in a Raman fibre amplifier and frequency-doubled in a resonant cavity to 589 nm, about 22 W per beam for ESO's 4LGSF. The hard part of Raman fibre amplification is suppressing stimulated Brillouin scattering at high power while keeping the linewidth far narrower than the sodium hyperfine structure. To raise the return, the laser is circularly polarised to optically pump atoms into the cycling transition, and about a tenth of the power is shifted to the D2b frequency as a repumper so atoms do not stay in the non-absorbing ground state; Larmor precession in the geomagnetic field weakens the pumping.
units.model: 1178.32 nm/2 = 589.16 nm，光頻 ν = c/λ ≈ 508.9 THz。都卜勒寬度約 1.05 GHz、自然線寬約 10 MHz，窄線寬雷射一次只激發約 1% 的速度族群。強度：20 W、大氣透過率 0.85、中氣層光點半高全寬 1.2″（直徑 ≈ 90 km × 1.2″ ≈ 0.52 m，面積 ≈ 2,150 cm²），I ≈ 17 W/2,150 cm² ≈ 7.9 mW/cm²，約為循環躍遷飽和強度 6.26 mW/cm² 的 1.3 倍，所以再加功率的回報會遞減。~1178.32 nm/2 = 589.16 nm, an optical frequency ν = c/λ ≈ 508.9 THz. With a Doppler width near 1.05 GHz and a natural width near 10 MHz, a narrow-linewidth laser excites only about 1% of the velocity classes at once. Intensity: 20 W, 0.85 atmospheric transmission and a 1.2″ FWHM mesospheric spot (diameter ≈ 90 km × 1.2″ ≈ 0.52 m, area ≈ 2,150 cm²) give I ≈ 17 W/2,150 cm² ≈ 7.9 mW/cm², about 1.3 times the 6.26 mW/cm² cycling-transition saturation intensity, so extra power brings diminishing returns.
units.verify: 以波長計與鈉蒸氣參考室確認並鎖定絕對頻率，以 Fabry–Pérot 掃描確認線寬與 D2b 邊帶的功率比例，以功率計與偏振分析儀量出光功率與圓偏振度；在天上以相同功率切換圓與線偏振、開關 D2b 回泵，記錄回波光子數比例並與模擬比較。~Confirm and lock the absolute frequency with a wavemeter and a sodium reference cell, check linewidth and the D2b sideband power fraction with a scanning Fabry–Pérot, and measure output power and degree of circular polarisation with a power meter and polarisation analyser; on sky, at fixed power, switch between circular and linear polarisation and toggle the D2b repumper, recording the return-photon ratios for comparison with simulation.
units.failure: 放大器若在高功率出現受激布里淵散射，反向功率可能傷害前級元件，保護機制自動降功率，導引星亮度在夜間無預警下降；偏振純度劣化或回泵邊帶失鎖會讓回波減少數十個百分比，而雷射輸出功率看起來完全正常。~If the amplifier develops stimulated Brillouin scattering at high power, backward power can damage upstream components and protection logic cuts the power, dimming the guide star without warning; degraded polarisation purity or a lost repump sideband cuts the return by tens of percent while the laser output power looks perfectly normal.
units.misconception: 只要把雷射功率加倍，回波光子數就一定加倍。~Doubling laser power always doubles the returned photons.

units.anchor: 雷射發射望遠鏡與回波通量~Launch telescope and return flux
units.title: 發射望遠鏡、上行光點與回波光子預算~Launch telescope, uplink spot and return-photon budget
units.mechanism: 雷射經光束傳輸系統送到發射望遠鏡，ESO 4LGSF 每道光束直徑 30 cm；發射口徑太小時繞射使光點變大，太大則上行光束被湍流破碎，最佳值約為數倍 r₀。中氣層光點的大小決定回波的亮度分佈與波前感測器看到的光點寬度。回波光子預算是一條鏈：雷射功率、上行透過率、鈉層吸收比例、近乎等向的再發射、隨距離平方衰減、下行透過率、望遠鏡與感測器效率，每一環都要能量測並互相對得上。~The laser travels through a beam-transfer system to a launch telescope, 30 cm in beam diameter per beam for ESO's 4LGSF; too small a launch aperture enlarges the spot by diffraction, while too large a beam is broken up by turbulence on the way up, so the optimum is a few times r₀. The mesospheric spot size sets the return brightness distribution and the spot width seen by the wavefront sensor. The return-photon budget is a chain of laser power, uplink transmission, sodium absorption fraction, nearly isotropic re-emission, inverse-square dilution, downlink transmission and telescope and sensor efficiency, and every link must be measurable and consistent with the others.
units.model: 20 W 對應 5.93×10¹⁹ photons/s；τ = 0.038、上行透過率 0.85 得每秒 1.9×10¹⁸ 次散射；等向發射在地面的通量 1.9×10¹⁸/(4π × (9×10⁴ m)²) × 0.85 ≈ 1.6×10⁷ photons/(s·m²)，這是未計入飽和、拉莫進動與反衝的上限；天頂角 30° 時降到約 1.1×10⁷。取實際值為上限的一半，0.5 m 子孔徑、1 ms、系統效率 0.3：每幀約 600 個光子。~20 W is 5.93×10¹⁹ photons/s; with τ = 0.038 and 0.85 uplink transmission there are 1.9×10¹⁸ scatterings per second; isotropic emission gives a ground flux of 1.9×10¹⁸/(4π × (9×10⁴ m)²) × 0.85 ≈ 1.6×10⁷ photons/(s·m²), an upper bound before saturation, Larmor precession and recoil, falling to about 1.1×10⁷ at 30° zenith angle. Taking half the bound, a 0.5 m subaperture, 1 ms frames and 0.3 system efficiency, each frame receives about 600 photons.
units.verify: 在望遠鏡上以校正過的波前感測器或小型光度計量測實際回波通量，扣除背景後換算成 photons/(s·m²)，再除以雷射出口功率與同時段的鈉柱密度得到比回波，與上式及數值模擬比較；並以天頂角掃描驗證通量隨 1/L² 與氣團的變化。~On the telescope measure the actual return flux with a calibrated wavefront sensor or small photometer, subtract background, convert to photons/(s·m²), divide by the laser output power and the concurrent sodium column density to get the specific return, and compare with the estimate and with numerical simulation; scan zenith angle to verify the 1/L² and airmass dependence.
units.failure: 發射望遠鏡離焦或光束品質變差時，中氣層光點從 1.2″ 擴大到 2″ 以上，回波總數未必下降，但波前感測器的光點變大、質心雜訊上升，AO 表現變差；若只監看雷射出口功率而不監看回波，傳輸光路中某片鏡面的污染會被誤認為鈉層變薄。~If the launch telescope defocuses or beam quality degrades, the mesospheric spot grows from 1.2″ to beyond 2″; total return may not fall, but the wavefront-sensor spots grow, centroid noise rises and AO performance drops; monitoring only laser output power without the return lets contamination of a mirror in the transfer path be mistaken for a thinning sodium layer.
units.misconception: 鈉導引星的亮度只取決於雷射功率，與發射望遠鏡無關。~Sodium guide-star brightness depends only on laser power, not on the launch telescope.

units.anchor: LGS Shack–Hartmann 子孔徑光點~LGS Shack–Hartmann subaperture spots
units.title: 光點拉長、質心雜訊與 LGS 波前感測~Spot elongation, centroid noise and LGS wavefront sensing
units.mechanism: 鈉層有約 10 km 的厚度，從偏離發射點的子孔徑看過去，雷射光柱在天空上呈一條線段而不是一個點，這種透視拉長與子孔徑到發射點的距離成正比，方向在瞳面上呈放射狀排列。拉長方向的質心雜訊變大；鈉層剖面隨時間改變時光點質心也會位移，被誤讀成波前斜率。因此 LGS 波前感測器需要比自然星感測器更大的子孔徑視場與更多像素，並採用能處理拉長光點的質心演算法。~Because the sodium layer is about 10 km thick, a subaperture displaced from the launch point sees the laser column as a line segment on the sky rather than a point; this perspective elongation grows with the distance between subaperture and launcher and points radially across the pupil. Centroid noise rises along the elongation, and when the sodium profile changes with time the spot centroid moves and is misread as a wavefront slope. LGS wavefront sensors therefore need larger subaperture fields and more pixels than natural-star sensors, together with centroid algorithms that handle elongated spots.
units.model: 拉長角 ε ≈ b·ΔH/H²：ΔH = 10 km、H = 90 km，b = 8 m 時 ε ≈ 8 × 10⁴/(8.1×10⁹) rad ≈ 2.0″；b = 40 m（極大望遠鏡外緣子孔徑）時約 10″。質心雜訊 σ ≈ (FWHM/2.355)/√N：N = 600、未拉長 1.2″ 時約 21 mas；拉長方向 2.0″ 約 35 mas；10″ 的光點約 175 mas，需要更多光子或截斷視場。~Elongation ε ≈ b·ΔH/H²: with ΔH = 10 km and H = 90 km, b = 8 m gives ε ≈ 8 × 10⁴/(8.1×10⁹) rad ≈ 2.0″, and b = 40 m, an outer subaperture of an extremely large telescope, gives about 10″. Centroid noise σ ≈ (FWHM/2.355)/√N with N = 600 is about 21 mas for an unelongated 1.2″ spot, about 35 mas along a 2.0″ elongation, and about 175 mas for a 10″ spot, which demands more photons or a truncated field.
units.verify: 在波前感測器原始影像上量每個子孔徑光點沿放射與切線方向的寬度，對子孔徑到發射點的距離作圖，應呈線性並與鈉層厚度一致；改變每幀光子數，量各方向質心標準差隨 1/√N 的變化；同時把鈉雷射雷達的剖面變化與感測器回報的假離焦或假球差做相關。~On raw wavefront-sensor frames measure each subaperture spot's width along the radial and tangential directions and plot it against distance from the launcher, expecting a linear trend consistent with layer thickness; vary photons per frame and measure how the centroid standard deviation in each direction scales with 1/√N; correlate sodium-lidar profile changes with the false defocus or spherical aberration reported by the sensor.
units.failure: 子孔徑視場太小時，拉長光點被截斷，質心被拉向視場中心，鈉層剖面一變就產生假的波前斜率；這些假訊號在瞳面上呈放射對稱，AO 會當成真實離焦或球差去修正，使科學影像模糊。~With too small a subaperture field the elongated spot is truncated and its centroid pulled towards the field centre, so every change in the sodium profile creates false slopes; these false signals are radially symmetric across the pupil, and the AO corrects them as real defocus or spherical aberration, blurring the science image.
units.misconception: LGS 光點和自然星一樣是圓點，可以直接沿用自然星的感測器設計。~LGS spots are round like natural stars, so natural-star sensor designs carry over unchanged.

units.anchor: 鈉層高度變化與焦距追蹤~Sodium altitude variations and focus tracking
units.title: 鈉層高度、對焦追蹤與自然星低階感測~Sodium altitude, focus tracking and natural-star low-order sensing
units.mechanism: 雷射導引星位於有限距離，影像落在自然星焦面之後，且距離隨天頂角以 H/cos z 變化，所以 LGS 波前感測器必須裝在可移動的對焦平台上持續追蹤。更棘手的是鈉層重心高度本身會在數分鐘內變動數百公尺，LGS 看到的離焦一部分是大氣真實離焦、一部分是鈉層移動，兩者無法分辨。解法是讓 LGS 迴路的離焦只作為快速的相對量，再以自然星的低階真值感測器慢速校正絕對焦距，同一顆自然星通常也提供 tip-tilt。~A laser guide star at finite range images behind the natural-star focus, and its range changes as H/cos z with zenith angle, so the LGS wavefront sensor must ride on a moving focus stage. Worse, the sodium centroid altitude itself wanders by hundreds of metres within minutes, so the defocus the LGS reports is partly real atmospheric defocus and partly layer motion, and the two cannot be separated. The remedy is to treat LGS defocus only as a fast relative quantity and to correct absolute focus slowly with a natural-star low-order truth sensor, the same natural star that usually supplies tip-tilt.
units.model: 焦面位移 δ ≈ f²/L：等效焦距 f ≈ 120 m、L = 90 km 時 δ ≈ 14,400/90,000 m ≈ 160 mm；天頂角 30° 時 L ≈ 104 km、δ ≈ 139 mm，追蹤一夜要移動 20 mm 以上。鈉層高度變化 1 km 對 8.2 m 口徑產生的離焦 PV = (D²/8)(1/H − 1/(H + ΔH)) ≈ 8.4 m² × 1.22×10⁻⁷ m⁻¹ ≈ 1.03 µm，RMS ≈ 0.30 µm；對 39 m 口徑 PV 約 23 µm。~Focal shift δ ≈ f²/L: with an effective focal length f ≈ 120 m and L = 90 km, δ ≈ 14,400/90,000 m ≈ 160 mm; at 30° zenith angle L ≈ 104 km and δ ≈ 139 mm, so tracking over a night moves the stage by more than 20 mm. A 1 km change in sodium altitude produces defocus PV = (D²/8)(1/H − 1/(H + ΔH)) ≈ 8.4 m² × 1.22×10⁻⁷ m⁻¹ ≈ 1.03 µm on an 8.2 m aperture, about 0.30 µm RMS, and about 23 µm PV on a 39 m aperture.
units.verify: 同時記錄鈉雷射雷達量到的鈉層重心高度與 LGS 感測器回報的離焦，求兩者的相關與比例係數，應與 D²/8 的幾何關係一致；再比較真值感測器開關前後科學影像的焦距漂移，確認低頻焦距由自然星決定，並檢查對焦平台位置是否隨 1/L 正確追蹤。~Log the sodium centroid altitude from a lidar together with the defocus reported by the LGS sensor and derive their correlation and scale factor, which should match the D²/8 geometry; compare science-image focus drift with the truth sensor on and off to confirm that low-frequency focus is set by the natural star, and check that the focus-stage position tracks 1/L correctly.
units.failure: 若沒有真值感測器，鈉層緩慢上升 500 m 會讓 AO 迴路忠實地把約 0.5 µm PV 的假離焦加進科學光路，近紅外影像在數十分鐘內逐漸失焦，而操作員看到 LGS 迴路殘差一切正常。~Without a truth sensor, a slow 500 m rise of the sodium layer makes the AO loop faithfully add about 0.5 µm PV of false defocus to the science path, so the near-infrared image defocuses over tens of minutes while the operator sees perfectly normal LGS loop residuals.
units.misconception: LGS 的焦距只隨天頂角改變，鈉層本身的高度是固定的。~LGS focus changes only with zenith angle; the sodium layer altitude is fixed.

units.anchor: 多雷射星組與斷層重建~Multi-LGS asterism and tomography
units.title: 多雷射導引星斷層重建與互擾整合~Multi-LGS tomography and cross-talk integration
units.mechanism: 單顆雷射導引星的錐效應，以多顆導引星圍繞目標排成星組來補償：各導引星的光錐在不同高度的湍流層上覆蓋不同區域，斷層重建把各方向的量測合成三維湍流分佈，再投影到目標方向。VLT UT4 的 4LGSF 以四道 22 W 雷射服務 MUSE 與 HAWK-I 的自適應光學模組。多雷射同時運轉帶來新的整合問題：連續波雷射在低空的瑞利散射光柱會落進其他雷射的感測器視場形成互擾，各雷射的指向、功率與偏振必須一致，而星組幾何決定高層湍流的覆蓋程度。~The cone effect of a single beacon is compensated by an asterism of several laser guide stars around the target: each beacon's cone covers a different region of each turbulent layer, and tomographic reconstruction combines the directions into a three-dimensional turbulence estimate projected onto the target direction. The 4LGSF on VLT UT4 uses four 22 W lasers to serve the adaptive-optics modules of MUSE and HAWK-I. Running several lasers at once creates new integration issues: the low-altitude Rayleigh plume of each continuous-wave beam falls into other lasers' sensor fields as cross-talk, pointing, power and polarisation must match across lasers, and asterism geometry sets how well high layers are covered.
units.model: 離軸 θ 的導引星在高度 h 的足跡位移 h·θ：θ = 30″、h = 15 km 時約 2.2 m；θ = 10″、h = 10 km 約 0.48 m。足跡同時縮小為 D(1 − h/H)，h = 15 km 時為 8.2 × (1 − 15/90) ≈ 6.8 m。若四顆導引星位於半徑 30″ 的方形頂點，15 km 層的四個足跡各自錯開約 2 m，在目標方向的 6.8 m 圓內留下覆蓋較薄的區域，限制高層修正品質。~A beacon at off-axis angle θ shifts its footprint on a layer at height h by h·θ: about 2.2 m for θ = 30″ and h = 15 km, and 0.48 m for θ = 10″ and h = 10 km. The footprint also shrinks to D(1 − h/H), 8.2 × (1 − 15/90) ≈ 6.8 m at 15 km. With four beacons at the corners of a square of radius 30″, the four footprints on the 15 km layer are offset by about 2 m each, leaving thinly covered regions inside the 6.8 m target circle that limit high-layer correction.
units.verify: 以模擬或已知湍流剖面計算各高度的覆蓋率，並與 SCIDAR 或 MASS 剖面比對預期性能；在天上逐一開關各雷射，量其他感測器的背景變化，建立互擾地圖與對應的子孔徑遮罩；比較單雷射與多雷射模式的 Strehl 與視場內均勻性。~Compute layer-by-layer coverage from simulation or known turbulence profiles and compare expected performance with SCIDAR or MASS profiles; on sky switch each laser on and off in turn, measure the background change in the other sensors, and build a cross-talk map with matching subaperture masks; compare Strehl and field uniformity between single-laser and multi-laser modes.
units.failure: 若沒有互擾遮罩，相鄰雷射的瑞利光柱在部分子孔徑形成條狀背景，質心被拉偏，重建器把它當成高層湍流修正，影像在特定方向出現系統性拖影；某道雷射功率偏低而斷層權重未調整時，該方向的雜訊會污染整個重建。~Without cross-talk masks, a neighbouring laser's Rayleigh plume lays a streak of background across some subapertures, biases their centroids and is reconstructed as high-altitude turbulence, giving systematic image smearing in particular directions; if one laser runs low in power and the tomographic weights are not adjusted, noise from that direction contaminates the whole reconstruction.
units.misconception: 雷射導引星越多越好，彼此之間不會有任何干擾。~More laser guide stars are always better and never interfere with each other.

units.anchor: 航空與衛星協調及驗收紀錄~Aircraft and satellite coordination and acceptance log
units.title: 運轉協調、性能驗證與工程交接~Operational coordination, performance validation and handoff
units.mechanism: 雷射導引星的運轉必須遵守當地航空主管機關與天文台的安全規範：依核准程序協調空域，運轉中由觀察員或自動偵測系統在航機接近時中止發射，並依衛星協調單位提供的預測關閉時段暫停發射；這些是程序與紀錄要求，不是雷射操作細節。性能驗證則把前面各單元的模型對上天上的量測：回波通量、光點尺寸、LGS 與 NGS 模式的 Strehl、斷層重建的視場均勻性。交接文件要記錄雷射頻率與功率設定、偏振與回泵狀態、互擾遮罩、對焦追蹤參數與每晚的關閉事件。~Laser guide-star operation must follow the rules of the local aviation authority and the observatory: airspace is coordinated under an approved procedure, propagation is halted by spotters or automatic detection systems when aircraft approach, and it is paused during predicted closure windows supplied by a satellite-coordination body; these are procedural and record-keeping requirements, not laser operating details. Performance validation matches the earlier models against on-sky data: return flux, spot size, Strehl in LGS and NGS modes and field uniformity of the tomographic reconstruction. The handoff file records laser frequency and power settings, polarisation and repump state, cross-talk masks, focus-tracking parameters and each night's closure events.
units.model: 關閉損失：一夜 10 小時內有 25 次、每次 30 s 的預測關閉，共 750 s，約 2.1% 的時間，且每次恢復還需重新閉迴路。比回波正規化：量得 8×10⁶ photons/(s·m²)、出口功率 20 W、鈉柱密度 4×10⁹ cm⁻²，回波/功率 = 8×10⁶/20 = 4×10⁵ photons/(s·m²·W)，再除以以 10⁹ cm⁻² 為單位的柱密度 4，得 1×10⁵，可作為跨夜比較的系統健康指標。~Closure loss: 25 predicted closures of 30 s in a 10-hour night total 750 s, about 2.1% of the time, plus the time to re-close the loop after each. Normalised return: with a measured 8×10⁶ photons/(s·m²), 20 W output and a column density of 4×10⁹ cm⁻², return per watt is 8×10⁶/20 = 4×10⁵ photons/(s·m²·W), and dividing by the column density in units of 10⁹ cm⁻², 4, gives 1×10⁵, a system-health index comparable across nights.
units.verify: 每晚記錄雷射功率、頻率鎖定狀態、回波通量、鈉柱密度與關閉事件，產生正規化回波的時間序列並設告警門檻；驗收時對同一目標分別以 NGS AO 與 LGS AO 量 Strehl 與半高全寬，差異應符合錐效應與 tip-tilt 預算；安全協調紀錄由天文台安全負責人審核歸檔。~Log laser power, frequency-lock status, return flux, sodium column density and closure events every night, build a normalised-return time series with alarm thresholds; at acceptance measure Strehl and FWHM on the same target in NGS AO and LGS AO modes and confirm that the difference matches the cone-effect and tip-tilt budgets; the observatory safety officer reviews and archives the coordination records.
units.failure: 若關閉事件與 AO 迴路沒有自動聯動，雷射中止後迴路仍以失去光源的 LGS 量測運轉而發散，恢復時需重新捕獲；交接文件若缺少回泵與偏振設定，下一個團隊遇到回波下降時無從判斷是鈉層、雷射還是光路的問題。~If closure events are not interlocked with the AO loop, the loop keeps running on a vanished LGS signal after propagation stops and diverges, forcing a full reacquisition; a handoff file missing repump and polarisation settings leaves the next team unable to tell whether a return drop comes from the sodium layer, the laser or the optical path.
units.misconception: 雷射導引星的安全只需注意雷射本身，與航空和衛星協調無關。~Guide-star laser safety concerns only the laser itself, not aviation or satellite coordination.

example: LGS 光子與對焦練習：8.2 m 望遠鏡以單道 20 W 鈉雷射在天頂角 30° 觀測。距離 L = 90 km/cos 30° ≈ 104 km、氣團 1.155，單程透過率 0.85^1.155 ≈ 0.83；散射率 = 0.038 × 5.93×10¹⁹ × 0.83 ≈ 1.87×10¹⁸ s⁻¹；地面通量 = 1.87×10¹⁸/(4π × (1.04×10⁵ m)²) × 0.83 ≈ 1.1×10⁷ photons/(s·m²)，取一半為 5.7×10⁶。0.5 m 子孔徑、1 ms、效率 0.3：約 430 光子/幀，1.2″ 光點的質心雜訊 ≈ (1.2/2.355)/√430 ≈ 25 mas。LGS 感測器焦面位移 δ ≈ 120²/1.04×10⁵ m ≈ 139 mm。tip-tilt 由一顆 R = 17 星提供：1×10⁸ × 300 nm × 10^(−6.8) ≈ 4,750 photons/(s·m²)，乘 51.9 m²、效率 0.2、除以 200 Hz，約 250 光子/幀，0.8″ 光點的傾斜雜訊約 22 mas。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實機規格。~LGS photon and focus exercise: an 8.2 m telescope uses one 20 W sodium laser at 30° zenith angle. Range L = 90 km/cos 30° ≈ 104 km, airmass 1.155 and one-way transmission 0.85^1.155 ≈ 0.83; scattering rate = 0.038 × 5.93×10¹⁹ × 0.83 ≈ 1.87×10¹⁸ s⁻¹; ground flux = 1.87×10¹⁸/(4π × (1.04×10⁵ m)²) × 0.83 ≈ 1.1×10⁷ photons/(s·m²), halved to 5.7×10⁶ for real losses. A 0.5 m subaperture with 1 ms frames and 0.3 efficiency collects about 430 photons per frame, and a 1.2″ spot gives centroid noise ≈ (1.2/2.355)/√430 ≈ 25 mas. The LGS sensor sits δ ≈ 120²/1.04×10⁵ m ≈ 139 mm behind the natural-star focus. Tip-tilt comes from an R = 17 star: 1×10⁸ × 300 nm × 10^(−6.8) ≈ 4,750 photons/(s·m²), times 51.9 m² and 0.2 efficiency, divided by 200 Hz, gives about 250 photons per frame and about 22 mas tilt noise for a 0.8″ spot. Values are teaching assumptions, not any facility's specification.
history: 1982 年 William Happer 提出利用中氣層鈉原子做人造導引星，1985 年 Foy 與 Labeyrie 在天文文獻中公開發表此概念；1990 年代中期 Lawrence Livermore 國家實驗室在 Lick 天文台 3 m Shane 望遠鏡上首次以鈉雷射導引星明顯改善天文影像。2004 年 Keck II 開始提供鈉雷射導引星自適應光學，ESO 於 2016 年 4 月在 VLT UT4 啟用以拉曼光纖雷射為基礎的四雷射導引星設施 4LGSF，極大望遠鏡則規劃以多道雷射進行斷層自適應光學。本課只重建公開的物理與工程邏輯，不涉及雷射操作程序。~In 1982 William Happer proposed using mesospheric sodium as an artificial guide star, and in 1985 Foy and Labeyrie published the concept in the astronomical literature; in the mid-1990s Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory first achieved clear image improvement with a sodium laser guide star on the 3 m Shane telescope at Lick Observatory. Keck II began offering sodium laser-guide-star adaptive optics in 2004, ESO commissioned the Raman-fibre-laser-based Four Laser Guide Star Facility on VLT UT4 in April 2016, and extremely large telescopes plan multi-laser tomographic adaptive optics. This course reconstructs only public physics and engineering logic, not laser operating procedures.
